notice: ABI byte lock. The single ABI generation input is the verbatim latchset public-domain PKCS #11 v3.2 header vendored as spec/vendor/pkcs11.h with a measured SHA-256. No hash is fabricated: verify with python3 scripts/validate-spec.py from haskoki/. One file suffices: v3.2 is a strict superset of every older interface (same names, values, layouts, and function order), so per-version vendoring would only duplicate bytes. OASIS/TC sets were removed (see spec/source-issues.json SRC-08); no non-open-licensed header remains in the tree.
